units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution), seconds; x right, y down

camera.motion: static (tripod, overhead). Phase-correlation shift of the static upper-left region vs frame 0 stays within |dx|<0.6 px, |dy|<0.9 px for all 30 frames (tracks/camera_shift.csv) - no correction needed.
camera.view: near-orthographic overhead view of a flat desk; table plane ~ parallel to image plane

coffee_cup.description: white ceramic mug full of black coffee, held by its handle by a right hand entering from the bottom-right (black smartwatch on wrist). The only rigid moving object.
coffee_cup.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of the circle fitted to the outer edge of the mug's top rim (visible centre of the cup seen from above). coffee_cx/cy (centre of the dark coffee disc) agree within ~10 px and is an alternative.
coffee_cup.visible_frames: 0-27 (frame 28 at most a sliver at the bottom edge; frames 28-29 not trackable)
coffee_cup.fully_in_frame_frames: 0-19 (cup body touches the bottom edge from frame 20; rim circle touches/leaves bottom edge from ~frame 22-23)

size_px_frame0.visible_cup_extent_incl_side_wall_x: 3045-3463 (bbox, mug side wall seen in perspective to lower-left; handle under fingers)

coffee_cup.apparent_size_change: cup is lifted toward the camera while moving: rim diameter 417 (f0-4) -> 427 (f10) -> 459 (f15) -> 487 (f20) -> ~500 (f23-27); coffee diameter 373 -> 399 (f10) -> 414 (f15) -> 447 (f20) -> 484 (f27). Use the size measured in the same frame(s) the question's prior refers to; the annotator convention would normally use one pixel length (e.g. frame 0 rim diameter ~417 px).
coffee_cup.motion_path: frames 0-3 essentially at rest at ~(3248,1296) (jitter <=10 px, slow downward creep as the lift begins); from frame 4 moves down-left in a nearly straight line toward the bottom edge, accelerating to ~75-95 px/frame by frames 13-22; reaches ~(2060,2289) at frame 27 and exits through the bottom edge. Net path direction ~ 140 deg from +x (down-left; dx -1188, dy +996 px from f0 to f27).

hand.description: person's right hand/forearm with black smartwatch, holding the mug handle; moves with the cup. Only rough bbox recorded (hand_bbox column, 'x0 y0 x1 y1', from foreground minus cup; includes forearm, unreliable at frame edge).
hand.visible_frames: 0-~28 (enters from bottom/bottom-right edge, always cut by frame edge)

laptop.desc: silver MacBook-style laptop, upper-left, screen partly out of frame at top
laptop.note: screen/top cut off by frame; bbox approx x 450-2285, y 0-1271

pencil.desc: wooden pencil, unsharpened end up at (2272,945), tip down at (2513,1660), between laptop and kraft notebook

airpods_case.desc: white rounded-square earbuds case right of the pencil

kraft_spiral_notebook.desc: brown kraft-paper spiral notepad, centre-bottom, rotated ~40 deg, spiral along upper-left edge

cactus_pot_with_saucer.desc: small terracotta pot with cactus on white round saucer, top centre

brown_leather_wallet.desc: tan leather wallet/organiser with strap, on a dark grey notebook, upper right

dark_grey_notebook.desc: dark grey hardcover notebook under the wallet, upper right, partly out of frame at top/right
dark_grey_notebook.reliability: partly out of frame; not measured

polaroid_photo.desc: instant photo of two people lying on the wallet

colour_cards.desc: stack of paint-swatch cards (orange 'BLGR / Blogger', brown, beige) lower-left, partly out of frame

desk.desc: light pine wood plank table filling the background

events.event: cup at rest held in hand
start of motion (cup lifted and moved down-left)
events.note: small creep from frame 1-3 (<= 10 px); clear motion starts frame 4-5

events.event: cup body reaches bottom frame edge
